items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: The interviewer mentions Mrs. TJ Samms as a neighbor/landlord figure in the neighborhood, but the interviewee (George Lewis) does not respond with any personal interaction or relationship details regarding her.

ctx.x: Canap Street. But her Elks place is along in the...
Oh, yes. They had Mrs. TJ Samms cross the street, Mrs. McCall, Mrs. Morris. But all them people moved, you know, uptown because the neighborhood had gotten to be so bad.
Now, what kind of work did you do when you worked for them? Did you cook for them?
